title: We had a great time...
text: We had a great time touring the Triana neighborhood with Eyrian. Some of the places the tour normally would have gone to were closed because it was a national holiday, but she was able to pivot to still give us a great experience. I loved the way she blended the history of Triana with the history of the food in a way that was both fun and informative. And, of course, all the tapas we tried were delicious! At the end, she gave us a few recommendations of other places we might want to check out in the area. Definitely a great tour to take to get out of the center of Seville.
author: Tiarra_J

title: Great tour
text: Fabio was an excellent guide. Very knowledgeable about what we were eating. Enjoyed see the market and the surrounding area. Extra bonus it was just us.
author: Helsbels123456

title: A great way to learn about Spanish Food!
text:
Great way to learn about the local culture and food in the city! 

A little standing heavy, but worth it. 

Wish there was a dessert option, though I understand this tour was held at Tapas Time.
author: Kerstin_G

title: Fun Food Tour!
text: We did a food tour with Dani and we had a great time! We felt like we got a lot of food for the price and the options were great! Dani was also very knowledgeable and friendly.

title: Nice ambience
text: What a great time in this market with bar and small delicacies. Pollo, who had taught us a lot about Spanish wines from the area, also served me deliciously fresh oysters. No question was too much! Thank you Pollo! Keep it up! The two Swiss from a wine region.
author: 205christlr

title: Tapas in Triana
text: This was a great opportunity to try some very local tapas bars in the Triana district, off the tourist trail.
author: Mary_W

title: Market and Tapas Tour.
text: Really enjoyable experience. Our guide, Fabio, was friendly, approachable and extremely knowledgeable about both the local culture, cuisine and history. The tapas and drinks were generous in size: freshly made and very tasty. I thoroughly recommend this activity!
author: Terence_M

title: Great food,&  interesting history
text: Fabio was an excellent guide. We enjoyed the food and listening to the history of the lovely      little corner of Triana.
author: Lisa_E

title: Nice food, drinks and history
text: Easy to get to the market, learned history of the neighborhood and the local foods.  The tastings were just right and timing was great
